summary: The model substantially diverges from the approved target. Required arm and foot regions are within the close-up frames, but rear claws are partly occluded and cannot all be verified. Visual failures are separate from the supplied deterministic warning.

findings.message: Visual: Rounded, bead-like limbs, a domed head, paddle-like muzzle, and short segmented tail do not match the target's integrated reptilian anatomy, elongated armored head, long curved tail, or broad dorsal shields.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the major anatomical masses and silhouette against the approved target before refining surface details.

findings.message: Visual: The face is approximately bilateral, but the projecting flat muzzle, separate oval lower jaw, bulbous cheeks, and exposed yellow cheek wedges do not form the target's coherent armored reptilian face. Vent orientation cannot be confidently verified.
findings.recommendation: Integrate crown, muzzle, and jaw into a continuous tapered head; recess the eyes and clearly orient the vents.

findings.message: Visual: All three front claws on each foot are visible and project forward, but their angular stepped profiles differ from the target's curved talons. Rear claw roots and tips are not all clearly exposed, so backward orientation and freedom from burial cannot be verified. This is occlusion, not cropping.
findings.recommendation: Provide unobstructed rear-oblique foot views showing every rear claw from root to tip; refine the front claws into continuous tapered talons.

findings.message: Visual: The dorsal forms read as narrow, simple overlapping plates or fins rather than the target's broad, fractured storm shields. Seven distinct shield forms cannot be confidently verified.
findings.recommendation: Create seven individually readable, broad angular shields with broken contours and branching fissures.

findings.message: Deterministic report: Height/depth ratio is 1.2663, below the supplied 1.35 review threshold. The screenshots nevertheless show an upright stance without arm support.
findings.recommendation: Recheck the ratio after silhouette revisions and assess tail depth separately from torso posture.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, tail, and dorsal silhouette substantially differ from the approved target.
Approximate symmetry is present, but the muzzle and jaw read as disconnected flattened parts; coherent facial construction and vent orientation are not established.
Both close-ups include shoulder attachments, upper and lower arms, and complete hands. Arms remain externally readable through their length, with no visible passage through the torso.
Three forward-projecting front claws are visible on each foot. Every rear claw's backward orientation and exposed tip cannot be verified because of occlusion.
Front and side views show an upright torso carried by the legs, with freely hanging arms.
Generic biped, tail, and dorsal-fin anchors remain, but the approved lineage's distinctive head, integrated musculature, sweeping tail, and broad shield silhouette are not preserved.
Visible dorsal forms are simple plates or fins without convincing shattered-shield construction; seven distinct shields cannot be verified.
The legs are substantially heavier than the short arms. Side views show bent knees and a raised-hock configuration, while the feet provide a broad supporting base.
